title: Direct source-ideal witness proves ambient membership
situation: For I=(6), element 6 has the direct source-ideal witness 6=6*1.
attempted_conclusion: Accept ambient membership using the separate source-ideal proof.

expected.reason: The direct cofactor proves membership in the ambient ideal.

sources.anchor: theorem mem_satMem {I : Ideal Int} {f g : Int} (h : I g) : SatMem I f g :=
def sixes : Ideal Int := fun n => ∃ k, n = 6 * k
